authority.source_voltage_status: initial_test_setting_only; exact qualified source range remains Power Authority work

prototype_validation_required: V100/SXM2 enable, reset, inhibit, and power-good sequencing at this carrier
installed startup current and peak/load-step amplitude and slew
current distribution through the mapped SXM2 contact field
installed connector, harness, copper, protection, and cooler temperature rise
brownout, protection trip, controlled shutdown, and restart behavior
PCIe enumeration and GPU firmware/driver behavior
preconditions: assembly identity and connector/protection/cooler inspection recorded
integrated Phase 24 source/bus and applicable ERC/DRC/connectivity/DFM gates closed
Power Authority exact source, connector/harness, protection, drop, thermal, and shutdown record signed before full-envelope test
cooling and emergency source disconnect ready
current-limited source, DMMs, transient recorder/scope, current measurement, and thermal instrumentation available with IDs/calibration recorded
instrumentation: regulated 12 V source with current limit, readback, and remote disable
two DMMs or equivalent voltage/current instruments
oscilloscope/transient recorder for source, bus, rails, enable, power-good, reset, inhibit, and current
calibrated current probe or known Kelvin shunt
host logs for CM5, PCIe, driver, GPU, fan/pump and reset state

staged_current_ceiling_a.note: test-energy ceiling; not a load requirement
raise only after stable review and signed source limit
only the signed source/bus limit after all closure gates

stages.name: unpowered_inspection_and_resistance
measurements: raw and protected 12 V to return resistance/diode behavior
stages.pass_condition: no unexplained stable near-short, polarity/protection/return identity agrees with released design, unknown contacts remain undriven
stages.failure_action: no power; preserve resistance and inspection record for authority review

stages.name: cold_plug_protected_bus_modules_absent
stages.pass_condition: no persistent current limit, uncontrolled rail, unexplained protection heating, or back-power
stages.failure_action: disable source and investigate before changing limit

stages.name: local_regulator_and_control_rails
stages.pass_condition: each rail and control signal stays inside exact released component/net contract with stable power-good and intended polarity/timing
stages.failure_action: power off; no probing or rework while energized

stages.name: cm5_only
stages.pass_condition: host operation and local rails remain stable without back-power, reset loop, cooling loss, or unexplained temperature rise
stages.failure_action: disable source; retain host and rail logs

stages.name: v100_installed_inhibited
stages.pass_condition: no unexpected current path, rail disturbance, or unsafe control transition
stages.failure_action: remove source and do not drive unknown contacts

stages.name: first_enabled_low_load
stages.controls: cooling ready; approved enable truth table; lowest reproducible GPU load
stages.pass_condition: each bounded step completes without current-limit event, rail/control fault, cooling loss, or thermal limit violation
stages.failure_action: power down before changing ceiling; preserve synchronized raw records

stages.name: full_product_envelope
stages.prerequisite: signed source/bus, protection, copper/return, thermal, cooling, and load-step closure
stages.pass_condition: defined Power Authority waveform, duration, droop/recovery, thermal, and shutdown limits pass on recorded hardware

measurements_required: J1 power-field voltage and return drop
CM5_5V, BRIDGE_3V3, BRIDGE_1V1 rail values and transients
EN, PG, reset, PERST#, V100 inhibit and enable timing
connector, harness, copper, protection, regulator, cooler and board temperatures
CM5, PCIe, GPU and driver logs
mandatory_shutdown: smoke, odor, arcing, visible damage, connector discoloration, mechanical movement, or loss of cooler contact
persistent source current limit, unexpected protection trip, or unqualified parallel-path imbalance
rail or protected-bus voltage outside exact declared range, uncontrolled overshoot/oscillation, or failed recovery
unsafe EN/PG/reset/PERST#/inhibit transition or restart loop
published absolute maximum or approved test thermal limit reached
connector/harness temperature-rise limit exceeded or measurement invalid
cooling loss, required telemetry unavailable, or abnormal rails/current accompanying PCIe failure
operator cannot explain current path, return voltage, power-good state, or protection response
fault_shutdown: assert V100 inhibit or endpoint disable if responsive
allow rails to discharge and verify residual voltage is safe
preserve synchronized measurements and do not reapply power before authority review
run_record_fields: instrument IDs, ranges, bandwidth/sample rate, and calibration status
operator, timestamp, raw artifact hashes, stage disposition
completion_boundary: This artifact is complete when committed with its receipt and hashes; prototype operation remains unproven until raw hardware evidence exists.
